summary: Triton International Ltd filed a Form 6-K, the foreign private issuer equivalent of a routine US current report, furnishing its quarterly report for the period ended September 30, 2026. The exhibit is standard financial reporting: XBRL-tagged balance sheet, income statement, and equity rollforward data covering preferred stock, common stock, additional paid-in capital, retained earnings, and accumulated other comprehensive income across Q3 and year-to-date comparatives. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural event is disclosed. This is ordinary periodic reporting, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
